# VoxtNew's patches to MyGo (Auralink's)

0001 and 0002 are AudioSmith's patches (AudioSmith @f171c86), carried over unchanged: Auralink shares its UI kit and hits the same MyGo issues; their examples are AudioSmith's, where they were found. 0003 to 0007 are Auralink's own (VoxtNew started as Auralink, NOTICE).

VoxtNew builds against `third_party/mygo` (the `replace` in `go.mod`): MyGo at the version `go.mod` requires, with these patches, made by `scripts/vendor-mygo.sh` from the module cache. The copy leaves out MyGo's website, docs, examples, CI, tests and test data; `scripts/vendor-mygo.sh --check` tells whether it is exactly what the script makes. Never edit `third_party/mygo` by hand: change a patch and run the script. A patch's hunks in the parts the copy leaves out (its `docs/`) are skipped there and kept in the patch for upstream.

**Licence.** The patches in this directory are licensed under MyGo's MIT License (`third_party/mygo/LICENSE`), as the code they change is, so that they can go upstream unchanged. 0001 and 0002 come from AudioSmith (Apache-2.0), whose author offers them under the MIT License too; 0003 to 0007 come from Auralink, by the same author.

Keep each patch small and send it upstream (egoist/mygo); drop it when a release has the fix. With no patch left, delete `third_party/mygo` and the replace (`go mod edit -dropreplace github.com/egoist/mygo`).

| Patch | Why |
|---|---|
| `0001-coretext-own-width.patch` | On macOS a single-line text given exactly its measured width ended in "…", and wrapping text in a box of its own width dropped its last word to a second line. Two causes under MyGo 0.4.8: Core Text spaces a bracket apart from a letter of another script ("M4B（含章节）"), which the sum of advances left out; and long lines lost more than Core Text forgives (0.0002 DIPs) to float32 sums. MyGo 0.5.0 fixed the first upstream (`penAdvances`, `TestCoreTextLanguageSpacing`); the patch keeps the second: widths summed in float64, lines broken at width × (1 + 1e-6). On macOS 26.7, 0.5.5 alone fails `TestOwnWidthFits` for 10 long lines and passes with the patch. |
| `0002-select-list-scrolls.patch` | `ui.Select`'s list had no height limit and no scroll: a long one (Kokoro's 25 voices, the gallery's categories) ran off the bottom of the window, its last options out of reach. The list now scrolls in the room left below the trigger (at most 20 rows' worth); the highlighted option already scrolled into view. |
| `0003-nonactivating-window.patch` | Auralink's recording pill floats over the app the user dictates into; a click on its buttons must not activate Auralink, or the target app loses its focus and caret and ⌘V pastes elsewhere. `WindowOptions.NonActivating` maps onto the platform's `Focusable` (Windows already gives `WS_EX_NOACTIVATE`); on macOS the window is created as a `MyGoPanel` (NSPanel, `NSWindowStyleMaskNonactivatingPanel` at init, never key or main), and its surface tracks the mouse always (`NSTrackingActiveAlways`), so hover works while another app is active. Changing the class of a live window does not work (M0 spike S3: clicks stopped reaching the app). MyGo 0.5.0's `WindowOptions.Panel` is a nonactivating panel too, but one that takes the keyboard when shown, focused or clicked (Spotlight's): a click on the pill would take the keys from the app the user dictates into. So 0003 stays, as its own class (`MyGoNonactivatingPanel`) beside upstream's `MyGoPanel`. Such a window cannot take the keyboard: no text inputs. |
| `0004-vibrancy-style.patch` | The recording pill is a transparent panel that draws a rounded HUD with room around it for its own shadow; a blurred material behind the HUD (what the user dictates over shows through, frosted) needs the window's `NSVisualEffectView`, which `SetVibrancy` puts under the whole window, a rectangle that would show in the shadow's margin (`plugins/glass` blurs what MyGo painted, not the desktop). `Window.SetVibrancyStyle` insets the material from the window's edges, rounds it with a stretchable mask image (`maskImage` with cap insets) and can show it dark whatever the app's appearance; the insets hold as the window resizes. Other platforms ignore it. Checked on macOS 26.7 (mac-air, an off-screen accessory app): the effect view sits at the insets before and after a resize, with the mask and the dark appearance, and the app in front stays in front. |
| `0005-font-smoothing-off.patch` | On macOS MyGo rasterizes glyphs with Core Text's font smoothing while the user leaves it on, as AppKit draws text over an opaque background; smoothing emboldens light text the most, and the white text of Auralink's floating windows (the pill, the answer card, its language menu) over their dark HUD looked heavy to the user. `ui.View(v).FontSmoothing(false)` (and `Tester.SetFontSmoothing`) draws a window's text as Flat glyphs, unsmoothed, about a fifth less ink; thickened glyphs stay thick. The glyph cache is shared by the windows and keyed by shade, so other windows' text is unchanged: `TestFontSmoothingPerWindow` and `TestFlatCachedApart` (Linux and macOS), and the main window's capture was byte-identical before and after on mac-air. |
| `0006-prereleases.patch` | Auralink's first versions are betas, and Settings → About has a Beta updates switch (docs/release.md, docs/behavior.md §9.11); its updates come from actnow.dev, a stable feed (`updates.url`) and a beta one (`updates.url/beta`, whose manifest the site keeps the newer of beta and release). MyGo builds an app against one feed and makes deltas from that feed's versions only. With `updates.prereleases` (needs `url`, not `s3`), a version with a pre-release part points its files into `beta/`; the build links both feeds in (`packageUpdateBetaFeed`) and makes deltas from both channels' manifests, so that users of either channel get a delta of the next version; `mygo.Updater.SetPrereleases` makes `Check` read the beta feed (falling back to the stable one when it fails); `mygo.ErrNotPublished` (no manifest on the feed yet) is "up to date" in the plugin's window. It replaced a first 0006 for GitHub prereleases (the API, its rate limit) when Auralink moved to actnow.dev. Tests: `TestUpdaterPrereleases`, `TestWriteDeltasPrereleases`, `TestUpdatesConfig`, `TestNotPublished`; docs in `docs/updates.md` "Beta channel". |
| `0007-bundle-version.patch` | `mygo build` wrote the whole version into `CFBundleVersion`, `0.1.0-beta.1` for a beta, where Apple wants one to three integers. It now writes the numbers (`0.1.0`); `CFBundleShortVersionString` keeps the whole version, which `App.Version` reads and updates compare (`TestBundleVersion`). |

Make a patch: copy the module (`go env GOMODCACHE`/github.com/egoist/mygo@VERSION) somewhere writable, `git init` and commit it, change it, run its tests on the Mac and Linux, `git diff > third_party/mygo-patches/000N-name.patch`, then run `scripts/vendor-mygo.sh`.
